newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Orbital seen announcing Siemens deal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Orbital seen announcing Siemens deal.

text.p: Orbital Engine Corp Ltd is expected to announce on Thursday the formation of an alliance with Siemens Automotive Corp to develop its fuel injection technology, a source close to Orbital told Reuters on Wednesday.
The announcement is expected to be made at the Society of Automotive Engineers world conference in Detroit later today.

Orbital announced details of a planned alliance with Siemens in June last year and said the deal encompassed the manufacture, distribution, sales and further development of Orbital's charge injectors to global manufacturers of automotive, marine, motorcycle and recreational vehicle and liesure products.
Earlier on Wednesday Orbital requested that a trading halt be placed on its shares ahead of an announcement to be made to the market on Thursday.
Orbital shares last traded at A$1.15 on Wednesday, up seven cents from Tuesday's close.
